title: Creamy No-Cook Basil Sauce with Rigatoni
changes_from_base: A no-cook sauce of cottage cheese, Gorgonzola, basil and fresh tomato blended in the processor replaces the spicy cooked tomato sauce.
summary: Rigatoni tossed in a no-cook sauce of cottage cheese, Gorgonzola, basil and fresh tomato blended in minutes.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 3 litres of pasta water (0.5%)
ingredients.note: about 2½ tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Boil the rigatoni in 3 litres lightly salted water until al dente.

steps.title: Blend the sauce
steps.text: Meanwhile chop the garlic in the processor, then add the cottage cheese, Gorgonzola and basil and blend until smooth and pale green. The cottage cheese gives a creamy body with much less fat than cream.

steps.title: Add the tomato
steps.text: Pulse the tomato in just until it is in small pieces, so the sauce keeps some texture. Stir in the pepper and pine nuts and scrape into the serving bowl.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Drain the rigatoni well and stir it into the sauce straight away; the heat of the pasta warms the sauce through. Serve at once.

tips: Use the ripest tomato you can find.
Swap the Gorgonzola for Parmesan for a milder sauce.
Toss straight after draining so the heat warms the sauce.
storage: Best eaten straight away; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours for up to 1 day.
